title: Cobblemon YZ
description: Cobblemon pack filled with QoL/Performance mods. The included server has ALL pokemon, PvE trainers, bosses/raids, quests, hunts, breeding, outbreaks and more!
body:
This pack includes many Cobblemon-themed mods as well as QoL and Performance mods.

Join Cobblemon YZ via the multiplayer section to play with friends!


<details>
<summary>Server Features</summary>

- Encounter and catch **all** pokemon </br>
  
- Tera/Z-Moves/Dynamax/Ultraburst/Mega (includes **all** Z/A Megas) </br>

- PvE Trainers</br>
  
- Claim land </br>
  
- Breeding </br>
  
- Shiny Weekends </br>
  
- Raid Dens </br>
  
- Monthly Boss Pokemon Fights </br>
  
- Field lab questing </br>
  
- Outbreaks and Alphas </br>
  
- Hunting/Breeding Bounties </br>

- and more! </br>
</details>
